register.labelZh: TEAR 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tear about、tear around 和 tear round 可以描述人、動物或交通工具快速而充滿活力地四處移動。；tear apart 可以描述內心極度痛苦、物件遭到嚴重破壞,或群體變得四分五裂。；tear down、tear off、tear out 和 tear up 可以描述以不同方式移除或破壞事物。；tear at、tear away 和 tear somebody off a strip 有助你理解猛烈動作和非常嚴厲的責罵。
register.summaryEn: Tear about, tear around and tear round help you describe people, animals or vehicles moving very quickly and energetically. Tear apart can describe deep emotional pain, physical destruction or a group becoming divided. Tear down, tear off, tear out and tear up help you describe different ways of removing or destroying things. Tear at, tear away and tear somebody off a strip are useful for understanding forceful actions and very angry criticism.

questions.promptZh: 離開家人令諾拉內心十分痛苦。

questions.answerZh: 離開家人令諾拉內心十分痛苦。
